status: prepared only; no candidates, renders, model calls or quality results
definition: New concept structures for this repository's local author/revision experiments; no claim about model pretraining
leakage_limit: Public planning file, not a sealed test set. A future author must start in a new context with only its own brief and permitted runtime. Further debugging on these tasks retires their held-out status.

tasks.concept: 用人数树展示贝叶斯条件概率
tasks.audience: 理解人数和百分比、未学过贝叶斯公式的高中生
tasks.brief: 1000 人中 100 人有某情况。检测发现其中 80 人；其余 900 人中有 90 人也检测为阳性。展示为什么阳性后的概率是 80/170，而不是 80/100。
tasks.mechanism_to_preserve: 先分人群，再分检测结果；最后分母仅包含全部阳性人群。
tasks.checker_status: not implemented; cannot reuse softmax checker as a Bayes proof

tasks.concept: 向量的正交投影和剩余分量
tasks.audience: 知道二维坐标和向量加法的学生
tasks.brief: 把向量 (3,2) 分解成沿 (1,1) 方向的投影和与该方向垂直的剩余分量。画面同时保持原向量、投影、剩余分量可辨认。
tasks.mechanism_to_preserve: 投影系数为 dot(v,u)/dot(u,u)；投影加剩余等于原向量，剩余垂直于方向。
tasks.checker_status: not implemented; existing horizontal residual protocol does not verify 2D orthogonality

tasks.audience: 理解数组、乘法和加法的编程初学者
tasks.brief: 在 [1,2,0,3] 上滑动权重 [1,2]，逐项乘加得到 [5,2,6]。明确这是不翻转权重的 cross-correlation；不要悄悄混用数学卷积定义。
tasks.mechanism_to_preserve: 每次输出只对应当前两项窗口；显示乘积、求和和窗口移动的对应关系。
tasks.checker_status: not implemented; no current sequence-window geometry checker
